blocking_reason: The frozen Experiment F/A1 records do not define exact F-VALIDATION operator parameters for Normal or PortScan. F0 describes both profiles qualitatively. Experiment E contains multiple distinct approved Normal and PortScan profiles, but no prospective Experiment F record selects one for these six validation sessions. Choosing one now would infer or invent parameters, which this authorization explicitly prohibits.
resolution_required: Before collection, approve a prospective amendment that selects one exact bounded Normal profile and one exact bounded PortScan profile (tool, request/scan parameters, duration/timeouts, and evidence requirements) for the listed F-VALIDATION sessions. Then rerun F4-A0 without inspecting predictions.

Normal.experiment_f_text: Representative bounded benign HTTP, explicitly logged, no concurrent DDoS/PortScan in its window.
Normal.conflict: This does not fix request count, idle sequence, timeout, maximum duration, User-Agent, or exact command. Existing Experiment E profiles are not automatically Experiment F profiles.

DDoS.request_behavior: GET / only with a fixed 1.0–2.0 second wait between requests per simulated user; no adaptive optimization from model outputs.
DDoS.claim_limit: Single-generator session repetitions; not genuine distributed DDoS.

PortScan.experiment_f_text: Representative approved runtime PortScan profile preserving the evidence class that remediated RF-v2; bounded, controlled, separately labeled.
PortScan.conflict: This does not select scan type, timing template, retry/rate options, port range, or maximum duration. Existing approved Experiment D/E profiles differ materially.

ground_truth.source: Prospectively preregistered generator/session design only; never RF predictions.

independence.scope: Independent session/capture repetitions under the single-generator Amendment A1 scope; not independent physical generators.

model_freeze.same_vectors_rule: All three models must later receive the exact same frozen validation feature vectors.

extraction_contract.extractor: CICFlowMeter V3 provenance approved by Experiment E E3-A1

acceptance_gates.ddos_like_f1: >= RF-v3 +0.10 absolute on the same amended-scope evaluation flows
acceptance_gates.false_positives: No >0.02 absolute increase in Normal->DDoS or Normal->PortScan versus RF-v3
acceptance_gates.macro_f1: >= RF-v3 -0.02 with no class gate waived
acceptance_gates.normal_recall: >=0.98 and no more than 0.02 below RF-v3 on identical flows
acceptance_gates.portscan_recall: >=0.995 and no more than 0.005 below RF-v3
acceptance_gates.normal_and_portscan_f1: each >=0.98 of RF-v3 value on identical flows

operator_preparation.reason: Creating runnable nine-session commands would require selecting missing Normal and PortScan parameters.
operator_preparation.instruction: DO NOT START CAPTURE OR TRAFFIC. Resolve the prospective profile amendment first.
